BROWS.name: Signature Brows
BROWS.summary: Our full brow service: mapping, shaping, wax and tint for a balanced, polished finish that suits your face.

BROWS.name: Brow Lamination
BROWS.summary: A semi-permanent treatment that smooths, lifts and sets unruly or sparse brow hairs into a fuller, fluffy brow shape. Results last 4-6 weeks. Includes a custom tint and brow wax.

BROWS.name: Hybrid Brows
BROWS.summary: Hybrid brows follow similar shaping steps to a standard brow, but upgrade the colour to a hybrid stain, creating a fuller, makeup-like finish.

LASHES.name: Eyelash Tint
LASHES.summary: A semi-permanent tint that darkens your natural lashes for a fuller look without mascara.

LASHES.name: Korean Lash Lift & Tint
LASHES.summary: A Korean lash lift is a modern, gentle treatment that curls, lifts and nourishes your natural lashes from the root - no extensions or harsh perming chemicals. The result is a more noticeable, wide-eyed lift, finished with a tint for added depth.

LIPS.name: Lip Wax
LIPS.detail: Quick, gentle removal of hair from the upper lip.
LIPS.summary: Quick, delicate hair removal along the upper lip line for smooth, clear skin using soothing, sensitive hot wax.

LIPS.name: Chin Wax
LIPS.detail: Gentle removal of unwanted hair from the chin area
LIPS.summary: Smooth, precise hair removal along the chin line using gentle, sensitive hot wax with botanical post-wax care.

COMBOS.name: Brow Lamination & Korean Lash Lift & Tint
COMBOS.detail: Full Brow Lamination + Korean Keratin Lash Lift & Tint
COMBOS.summary: Brow lamination (wax, tint and sculpt) paired with a Korean lash lift and tint. Our most complete brow and lash combination.

COMBOS.name: Hybrid Brows & Korean Lash Lift & Tint
COMBOS.detail: Hybrid Stain Brows + Korean Keratin Lash Lift & Tint
COMBOS.summary: Hybrid Brows with a Korean lash lift and tint for defined brows and lifted, tinted lashes.
